platformSettings.title: Platform settings
platformSettings.subtitle: One value per setting, applied to every client. Each change is logged.

keys.rfq.target_offers: Number of offers that closes the window

hints.flow.pack_enabled: On: requests from plans that include quotes go through OSI's shortlist, the RFQ and then the Decision Pack. Off: every request ends at the report. Applies to searches finishing after the change; a request already on the pack flow stays on it.
hints.rfq.reply_to: Where suppliers' replies arrive. The platform sends from a no-reply address: without a reply address, a supplier who answers would be writing into a mailbox nobody reads. No RFQ leaves while this field is empty.
hints.rfq.window_hours: Counted from the moment the RFQ batch is sent. A window already open keeps the delay it was opened with.
hints.rfq.target_offers: The window closes as soon as this many offers are in, without waiting for the delay. Not the number of suppliers the search ranks — that is set per plan.
hints.pack.release_mode: Manual: staff validate and send each pack. Automatic: the pack goes to the client when its window closes, without review; a round closed with no offer always goes to a person. Applies to packs created after the change. Before switching to automatic, read "What review changed" under Decision Packs.
hints.fee.rate_bps: In basis points of the transaction amount, added on top: 300 = 3%. The settlement partner's own fees come on top of it. Nothing applies it until the money circuit has its legal opinion.
hints.flow.spec_validation: On: every new request waits until its buyer validates the specification; nothing is searched before. Off: the search starts as soon as the form is submitted. Applies to requests created after the change; a request already waiting for validation stays so, and its buyer launches it by validating.
hints.contracts.supplier_signature: Off: a supplier’s signature is recorded by the team from the countersigned PDF, as always. On: a supplier with an account can sign its own line in its portal; the team can still record a PDF for one with no account or who prefers paper. Switch on only after legal advice on what that signature is worth.
